title: Taskly v2.3.3 (Build 15.3) – Universal Device-Adaptive UI Compatibility & Vertical Scrolling Fix
releaseNotes:
# Taskly v2.3.3 (Build 15.3) — Universal Device-Adaptive UI Compatibility & Vertical Scrolling Fix

Taskly v2.3.3 (Build 15.3) brings the complete, production-grade Universal Android Device-Adaptive UI Compatibility System along with physical-device-tested vertical scrolling and touch-action improvements across all major Android manufacturers.

### Key Enhancements & Fixes
- Universal Android Device-Adaptive UI Compatibility System with native hardware detection.
- Centralized OEMCompatibilityManager covering OnePlus, realme, Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO, Samsung, Vivo, OPPO, and Motorola.
- Restored smooth vertical finger scrolling across Smart Lists and all main screens by eliminating conflicting overscroll containment on full-screen containers.
- Implemented touch-action: pan-y across all views and wrappers for instant hardware-composited touch panning without gesture dead-zones.
- Automatically resets scroll position to the top upon screen transitions, preventing midway scroll traps when navigating from long screens.
- Guaranteed bottom navigation clearance ensuring Tomorrow's Routines and the Daily Routine Summary card are 100% accessible.
- Retained isolated overscroll containment strictly on modal dialogs and overlays to preserve background scroll protection.
- Certified with 1,053 passing automated tests across 268 test suites and 15 cross-device render matrix simulations.

history.title: Taskly v2.3.1 (Build 15.1) – Smart Lists / Daily Routines Rendering Fix
history.summary:
# Taskly v2.3.1 (Build 15.1) — Smart Lists / Daily Routines Rendering Fix

Taskly v2.3.1 (Build 15.1) fixes an asynchronous rendering race condition in Smart Lists / Daily Routines where saved habits would intermittently fail to display upon opening the screen, prematurely showing the "No routines yet" empty state. This update introduces explicit loading and error states, background sync re-rendering, tab-switch refresh, and accurate Done/Pending counter synchronization.

### Key Fixes & Enhancements
- Fixed premature "No routines yet" empty-state rendering on initial load.
- Added visual loading state with spinner during routine fetch.
- Added dedicated error state with retry action.
- Fixed Done/Pending counter chip synchronization with rendered list.
- Fixed tomorrow routine list and counter updates.
- Added auto-refresh when switching tabs to Smart Lists.

history.title: Taskly v2.1.1 (Build 12.1) – Routine Deletion & Foreign Key Integrity Hotfix
history.summary:
# Taskly v2.1.1 (Build 12.1) — Routine Deletion & Foreign Key Integrity Hotfix

Taskly v2.1.1 (Build 12.1) addresses a critical routine deletion error on Supabase. Deleting a routine from today's list now immediately cleans up future and tomorrow occurrences. Removing tomorrow entries after parent routine deletion no longer triggers foreign key constraint violations, and orphaned completion records are safely pruned without application errors.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed foreign key constraint violation (smart_routine_completions_routine_id_fkey) when removing routines.
- Fixed deleted routines remaining visible in tomorrow's routine list.
- Fixed failed remove operations when deleting tomorrow entries after parent routine is deleted.
- Fixed orphaned completion records lingering after parent routine removal.

### Reliability Improvements
- Safe, idempotent deletion of remaining tomorrow entries without errors.
- Verified existence check before attempting completion state updates or upserts.
- Immediate UI synchronization across routine counts, daily summaries, and habit streaks upon deletion.

history.title: Taskly v2.0.0 – Build 11: Habit Streaks & Productivity Analytics
history.summary:
# Taskly v2.0.0 (Build 11) — Habit Streaks & Productivity Analytics

Introduced comprehensive habit streak tracking, robust 4-state routine lifecycle management (completed, pending, postponed, cancelled), intelligent carry-forward and next-day routine scheduling, streak reset safeguards, unified productivity analytics separating tasks from habits, and interactive in-app update announcements.

### What's New
- **Habit Streak Engine**: Intelligent habit tracking requiring an 80% daily qualification threshold to extend streaks, with current streak, longest streak, and consistency percentages.
- **4-State Routine Lifecycle**: Complete state machine supporting Completed, Pending, Postponed (carried forward to tomorrow), and Cancelled routines with full audit integrity.
- **Undo Cancellation**: Instantly restore erroneously cancelled routines back to pending, dynamically recalculating streak denominators without losing progress.
- **Next-Day Routine Planning**: Dedicated tomorrow view allowing advance scheduling, viewing carried-forward items, and occurrence isolation without affecting recurring routines.
- **Streak Reset Controls**: Dedicated reset modal with user confirmation to restart streak counters from zero while preserving routine definitions and historical task/routine analytics.
- **Dedicated Productivity Analytics**: Clear separation between Task Analytics and Routine/Habit Analytics in the Progress tab, with responsive charts and rate indicators.
- **In-App Update Announcements**: Native and web update modal highlighting new features upon upgrade, with notification duplicate prevention and permission guards.
- **Four-Theme Visual Polish**: Pixel-perfect layout across Light Mode, Dark Mode, Pet Mode, and Pastel Light Mode.

history.title: Smart Lists – Daily Routine Management
history.summary:
# Taskly v1.9.0 (Build 10) — Smart Lists

Introduced Smart Lists, a dedicated daily routine tracker with individual completion checkboxes, configurable summary notifications, carry-forward functionality, historical productivity reports, responsive paper layout, and seamless multi-theme integration.

### What's New
- **Daily Routine Management**: Simple routine creation, inline editing, and deletion with instant cloud synchronization.
- **Individual Completion Tracking**: Interactive checkboxes with date-specific completion state and reactive day progress tracking.
- **Configurable Daily Summary Notifications**: Automatic daily summary reminders (default 10:00 PM) scheduled via native Android Local Notifications.
- **Paper-Style Productivity Reports**: Visual paper document showing completed routines, incomplete items, completion percentages, and closing encouragement.
- **Carry-Forward Intelligence**: Option to carry forward incomplete routines into tomorrow's routine checklist or close them for today.
- **Historical Reports**: Dedicated history viewer to review exact saved snapshots of past daily performance without recalculation.
- **Responsive Mobile Layout**: 2-column statistics grid preventing horizontal overflow on all Android screen sizes.
- **Four-Theme Support**: Full visual polish across Light Mode, Dark Mode, Pet Mode, and Pastel Light Mode.
- **UI Refinements**: Premium golden pill badge in Profile and a styled red destructive Delete confirmation button.
